verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents a self-service screen or flow for requesting a transaction limit increase. The card spending permissions (e-commerce, ATM, contactless), MCC/currency spend-control rules, and the generic support Cases API are adjacent controls, not a limit-increase request capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can request a transaction limit increase directly from a self-service screen
